identity.title: Passive galaxies in the early Universe: ALMA confirmation of z ∼ 3-5 candidates in the CANDELS GOODS-South field
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present here the analysis of ALMA archival observations of 26 out of the 30 galaxies in the deep CANDELS GOODS-South field that we identified as passive at $z\sim3-5$

targets.name: 30 passive candidates in CANDELS GOODS-South (26 with ALMA data)

evidence.quote: found public observations for 26 out of 30 sources, belonging to a number of different programs

question.value: Do ALMA archival continuum observations confirm the passive nature of z~3-5 passive galaxy candidates selected by SED fitting, i.e. rule out dusty star-forming contaminants?

evidence.quote: ALMA data are used to verify the potential contamination from red, dusty but star–forming sources that could enter the sample due to similar optical–nearIR colours.
The observations have been carried out in Band 6 and Band 7, with different sensitivities, setups and configurations.
producing images with spatial resolution $>0.6$$''$ (see Table [1](#tab:list_programs))

analysis_steps.goal: Find and image archival ALMA data

method.value: Archive search at candidate positions; calibrate with ALMA scripts; image with CLEAN, natural weighting, tapering where needed

evidence.quote: We used "natural" weightings and *uv*-tapers when needed, producing images with spatial resolution $>0.6$$''$
we could securely assume that all were point-like sources in our ALMA images.

method.value: Pixel value at candidate position in PB-corrected map; error as std of pixels with similar PB correction (+/-10%), excluding one FWHM around source, 3 sigma clipping

evidence.quote: The associated flux error was measured by taking the standard deviation of all pixels in the map with similar coverage

validation.value: Number of 1-2 sigma detections consistent with normal noise distribution

evidence.quote: the number of 1 and 2$\sigma$ detections is consistent with a normal distribution of the signal-to-noise ratio

method.value: Weighted average of fluxes from different programs in same band; stack all sources by band and redshift bin (3<z<4, 4<z<5) and undetected only

evidence.quote: we have stacked the inferred flux densities by averaging the fluxes measured from different programs weighting them with the associated errors

method.value: Scale far-IR templates to flux, get L_IR(3-1100 micron), apply Kennicutt & Evans SFR calibration; 1 sigma upper limits (3 sigma for individual validation)

evidence.quote: The SFR has been computed from the total infrared luminosity between 3 and 1100 $\mu$m adopting the calibration of (cite: kennicutt12)

key_parameters.value: Reference template M10; also P08, E11 MS/SB, CE01, DH02, S18 (R_SB=1, 4)

evidence.quote: In the following we will refer to M10 as our reference model

assumptions.value: Old stellar heating neglected, so SFRs are conservative upper values

evidence.quote: The true SFRs are therefore likely to be lower than those inferred by us

assumptions.value: Lambda-CDM H0=70, Om=0.3, OL=0.7; Salpeter IMF

evidence.quote: we adopt the $\Lambda$-CDM concordance cosmological model (H$_0$=70 km/s/Mpc, $\Omega_M$=$0.3$ and $\Omega_{\Lambda}$=0.7)
The application of different models yields a range of resulting SFRs

method.value: Compare ALMA SFR limits with SED-fit star-forming solutions (P>5%) at z 0-6; compare with star-forming Main Sequence at given stellar mass

evidence.quote: We apply a criterion based on the requirement that all the star–forming solutions with $P$($\chi^2_{SF}$)\>5% are above the ALMA predictions.

results_numeric.quantity: Candidates at least 1 sigma below MS

findings_qualitative.value: No individual source detected above 3 sigma, nor in stacks

evidence.quote: we found no high-confidence (i.e., $>$3$\sigma$) detection on ALMA images for any of the candidates.

claims.hypothesis: The SED-selected candidates are truly passive rather than dusty star-forming
claims.experiment: Compare ALMA-based SFR limits with star-forming SED solutions
claims.result: 9 of 26 have all plausible SF solutions excluded at 3 sigma
claims.finding: These 9 are confirmed with high confidence

evidence.quote: We find that in 9 out of the total sample of 26 candidates (i.e., 35%)

claims.hypothesis: The sample is passive in a statistical sense
claims.result: At least half lie at least 1 sigma below MS; stacks undetected
claims.finding: Classification correct for at least half statistically

evidence.quote: The passive classification is on average confirmed at 1$\sigma$ for at least 50% of the sample.

why_this_data.value: Herschel too shallow; ALMA is the only tool to validate passive solutions

evidence.quote: Deep ALMA observations therefore provide, at present, the only tool for validating the passive solutions for our candidates.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: S18 library rejected as likely inappropriate and overestimating SFR

evidence.quote: we believe that the S18 library is likely inappropriate and overestimates the SFR for our candidates

limitations_admitted.value: Archival ALMA data not deep enough to confirm most candidates individually; FIR template choice spans nearly a decade in SFR

evidence.quote: currently available ALMA archive observations are not deep enough to individually confirm most of our candidates with high confidence
